**Finding: missing (IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)**

- **What the document has:** Only Section 2(d), which preserves TrueLink's ownership of the Interface — fine under the rule. "Client's Intellectual Property" is defined (p0012) but never used operatively. Section 10 makes our IP and "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" merely *confidential*, and p0078 confirms domain/Client Content ownership only on discontinuance of hosting.
- **Gap:** No affirmative statement that Client retains title to Client Content, Client IP and borrower/loan data, no ownership of (or licence to) the Support Services work product, and no no-joint-ownership language — so neither the preferred nor the fallback position is met.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** New Section 2(e) "Client Ownership," expressed as subject to the existing Section 8(d) Credit Data licence, with an assignment of Support Services results, a perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free licence back for embedded TrueLink IP, and an express bar on transfer or joint ownership. The comment offers the fallback (licence instead of assignment) if TrueLink resists assignment.
- **Not double-flagged:** Section 8(d)'s Credit Data licence is broad but is a non-exclusive licence (not an assignment) over narrowly defined, aged repository data excluding Client Proprietary Information; noted in the rationale only.
